model: CD2 Protocol Series duct / plant-room air quality sensor
equipment_type: Duct air quality sensor (CO2, VOC, PM, humidity, temperature)
applies_to: Veris CD2 Protocol Series duct and plant-room air quality sensors (and the Schneider SpaceLogic SCD2 twin) set to BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The CD2 Protocol Series is a duct or plant-room sensor that reports temperature, humidity, CO2, VOC and four particulate sizes (PM1, PM2.5, PM4, PM10) over BACnet MS/TP or Modbus. Three binary values handle CO2 automatic baseline calibration, display units and a forced 400 ppm baseline. It is a different, smaller object set than the CW2 wall sensor.
notes: The objects table has no access column; the three BVs are marked writable from their descriptions.
Objects marked * are kept through power outages and apply to LCD models only (as printed).
The table prints no units for VOC and PM objects; the temperature object is described in °C.
Schneider SpaceLogic SCD2 Series (guide GEX55240) prints the same table.

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP address and protocol, then read the measurements you need. The BVs are only for calibration and display.
setup: Device instance defaults to Vendor ID followed by the MS/TP address; Object_Identifier is writable.
gotchas: BV 10 CO2 FRC 400 re-baselines CO2 to 400 ppm; only write it in clean outdoor-level air.

points.name: CO2 FRC 400
points.description: Sets 400 ppm CO2 baseline when written active

note: Provided as-is. Point availability varies by firmware and options; verify against the live device.
